sentences.text: Jack Ryan Falahee -LRB- born February 20 , 1989 -RRB- is an American actor .

He is known for his role as Connor Walsh on the ABC television legal drama How to Get Away with Murder , and for playing Benjamin Stringfellow on the PBS historical drama Mercy Street .
